name: AWS Cloud Credit for Research — YZU / Hardware-Splicer

fields.project_title: Cloud-Reproducible Benchmarking of Evidence-Constrained AI Agents for Consequential Engineering Workflows

packet_requirements.description: Obtain written AWS confirmation that a graduate student enrolled at Yuan Ze University in Taiwan is currently eligible under the program's 'greater China region' exclusion wording.
Prepared route note with finite-project framing, milestones, sharing plan, service-map guardrails, 90–120 day review timing and eligibility-email wording.
After eligibility is confirmed, choose only AWS services genuinely required by the research workload and calculate a pricing-based budget.

compliance_checks: Do not infer Taiwan eligibility from unrelated Taiwan AWS programs; obtain a program-specific answer.
Do not submit a service salad or promise AWS dependencies that the research does not need.
Do not request the US$5,000 student cap automatically; derive the ask from actual service usage.
Do not build a time-critical project around rapid approval; official typical review cycle is 90–120 days and expedited review is unavailable.
Consider Research Drive as the lead asset if its repeatable/shareable cloud workflow is a stronger fit than Hardware-Splicer.
